$description: the design tokens of laaabs., the one source for every kit. w3c design tokens format. scripts/tokens.mjs turns it into generated/tokens/ for ui-web (css), ui-swift (swift), ui-android (kotlin) and ui-winui (xaml). the key is the token's name in ui-web; $extensions.com.laaabs.swift is its name in ui-swift where it differs, and .platforms lists the kits that carry it when not all of them do. only solid values live here: tints and the white-opacity ladder are derived in each kit (cyan at 12 %, white at 55 %).

white.$description: text and icons, and the white-opacity ladder

cyan.$description: the one signal: the dot, leds, focus, something running. never a surface

surface-2.$description: a raised card, the bar, a menu

surface-high.$description: hover and pressed on top of a card

separator-solid.$description: white 12 % flattened over bg, so crossing lines never stack their alpha

success.$description: status only: it worked (passed, online, healthy). always with a word or an icon. 9.8:1 on bg

danger.$description: status only: it failed or is down; destructive actions. always with a word or an icon. 5.8:1 on bg

attention.$description: status only: needs a look soon (queued, restarting). a signal, never a surface. 12.3:1 on bg

attention-text.$description: text on an attention tint: attention 56 % of the way to white. 15.9:1 on bg

important.$description: status only: needs a look now, before it is urgent. a signal, never a surface. 7.8:1 on bg

important-text.$description: text on an important tint: important 56 % of the way to white. 13:1 on bg

sans.$description: everything: 700 headings, 600 buttons and badges, 500 the rest
